ThinkByte: Mukul M, Harsha Thota, Samarpith Rout, Charan Kumar, Pavan Kalyan, Revanth Babu Raavi, Vamsi Rampalli
Sigmainfo: Magesh R, Sonam Dahake, Sandeep Phophaliya, to: Shiresha Madhury, Divya Mishra
Key Takeaways
Clarified lead qualification status by noting that the lead remains an inquiry pending follow-up with the sales team rather than being marked as MQL.

Outlined next steps for technical SEO improvements including setting up subfolders, executing technical checkups, integrating the Bing index plugin, and delivering a server log analysis report by next week.
Requested that Divya review the URL structure document by today to support landing page optimizations for Australia and US markets.
Established that blog topics for February, particularly for ecommerce, fintech, and BI, should be shared by Friday for review and alignment with the overall content strategy.
Emphasized tracking key performance metrics through Big Excel formulas to monitor traffic, leads, and engagement against set plans.
Action Items
Revanth Babu Raavi
Provide a server log analysis report covering the last 90 days by next week.
Share the document detailing requirements for creating GBP profiles for Australia.
After collecting backlinking data, share the strategies and tricks with the team.
Share the updated backlink tracking sub-sheet in the delivery tracker with Quora and Reddit task updates.
Share the strategy document and blog topics for February for team review.
Harsha Thota
Track metrics for the Sigma and Lendfoundry engagements using the Big Excel file and present the data in upcoming meetings on an alternate week basis.
Divya Mishra
Review the URL structure document and provide feedback by today.
Share the tax information as requested.
Sirisha Madhury
Review the end-of-keywords document and confirm if the keywords are approved for page creation.
Vamsi Rampalli
Pick up and share blog topic ideas for February by Friday for review.
Objective
Clarify lead qualification: Keyword inquiries are marked as inquiries pending sales follow-up before being confirmed as MQLs.
Launch and optimize website pages: US page is live and Australian page content audit is underway with technical SEO setup including subfolders, tags, and schema.
Improve campaign performance: Review metrics and finalize blog topics strategy for February to boost traffic and lead conversion.
Target Audience
US Shopify page is live; content language audit and query findouts are being edited for the Australian audience with planned technical requirements.
Focus on key verticals: Prioritize content and outreach for ecommerce, fintech, and BI segments.
Messaging & Positioning
Channels
Leverage website channels: Shopify page live for US with plans to deploy similar setup for Australia using standard URL structures.
Utilize content marketing channels: Kick off Reddit backlinking and Quora content initiatives to drive engagement.
Timeline
Server log analysis report expected by next week after combining recent 30-day files with additional data.
February blog topics to be shared by Friday for review.
Budget
Metrics
Last week metrics: Total users around 345 and sessions at 440; traffic trends stable with seasonal variations.
Track engagement: Use Big Excel formulas to monitor traffic, lead conversion, and overall performance metrics consistently.
Creative Requirements
Finalize landing page content: Ensure button integration and content tweaks are in place for quick go-live for Australia.
Implement LLO optimization: Install and configure the recommended Bing index plugin for enhanced crawl frequency.
Dependencies
Await sales follow-up: Conversion of inquiries to qualified leads is pending clarification from the sales team.
Technical setup prerequisites: Requires setting up subfolders, schema tags, and GBP profile creation for Australia.
Coordinate document reviews: Ensure Divya and team review shared documents regarding Reddit strategy and related tax details.
Risk
Seasonal traffic drop: Noted decline in traffic post-holiday season may affect overall performance.
Potential delays: Risks in timely content updates, server log analysis reporting, and GBP profile creation for Australia.
Lead Quality Improvement
Inquiry leads are currently not added as MQL; they are treated as inquiries until confirmed by the sales team and expected to become sales qualified leads.
Metrics Tracking Process
Metrics to be tracked include traffic numbers (345 users, 440 sessions) and lead performance; tracking will be updated using a Big Excel sheet with formulas and reviewed weekly or biweekly.
SEO Implementation Process

SEO steps include setting up subfolders (for seller and newsletter), conducting technical audits (tags, schema, page speed, mobile optimization), and using a simple URL structure for English-based countries.
GBP Profile Creation for Australia
GBP profiles for Australia need to be created; documentation with required details (sigma info IDs) will be prepared, and assistance may be taken from existing accounts.
Backlinking Strategy on Reddit
The team is collecting Reddit and Quora threads to implement backlinking strategies, with a focus on fintech, ecommerce, and BI based on existing case studies; a strategy document was shared.
